description: This file contains utility functions and classes for handling Avro schemas and data within Apache Spark, including schema inference, data type support checks, schema matching, and reading/writing Avro data.

classes.name: AvroUtils
classes.description: Object providing utility functions for Avro schema inference, data type support, schema matching, and data reading/writing within Spark.

classes.name: RowReader
classes.description: Trait defining an iterator-like interface for reading and deserializing records from an Avro file.

classes.name: AvroMatchedField
classes.description: Case class representing a matched pair of a Catalyst field and an Avro schema field.

classes.name: AvroSchemaHelper
classes.description: Helper class for matching and validating fields between Avro schemas and Catalyst schemas.

methods.name: inferSchema
methods.description: Infers Spark SQL schema from Avro files, optionally using a user-provided schema.

methods.name: supportsDataType
methods.description: Checks if a given DataType is supported for Avro serialization.

methods.name: prepareWrite
methods.description: Prepares the configuration and schema for writing data in Avro format.

methods.name: inferAvroSchemaFromFiles
methods.description: Infers an Avro schema from a list of files by reading a sample file.
